title: node.list, contract version 1
description: Lists the nodes the actor's regions reach (PRD 5.8, 5.10): a page of nodes in tree order, a node before the nodes below it. Every actor may run it; the anonymous principal may not. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Structure\Domain\Queries\ListNodes, and the generated codec reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace. Its result is node.list.result.v1.json.

after.description: The id of the last node the caller has; the page starts after it, in tree order. Null, or missing, starts at the first node.

limit.description: The most nodes the page holds, from 1 to 100. Missing is 50.
